# Project Setup {#project-setup .text-2xl .@xs:text-3xl .@lg:text-4xl .leading-tight .font-bold .flex .items-center .gap-[.5em] .grow .text-pretty .clear-right .xs:clear-none}

How to install Jumbo 7 Nextjs version
::::

::::::::::::::: {.flex .flex-col .[&>*+*]:mt-5 .whitespace-pre-wrap}
Starting up with a new Nextjs project? Don\'t worry, Jumbo offers a
starter-template for the Nextjs version which provides the base to your
project and then gradually you can start adding more and more components
(either from what we have show cased in the Jumbo Demo from the full
demo folder) or from the other third party libraries available.

:::

steps:
